notes.title: Optimization Patch
notes.notes:
[p]This optimization patch lowers the total size of the game by ~ 5GB.   

I optimized the textures in all levels one by one, which makes a huge difference.  

For lower end PCs/laptops you should also see a performance improvement.  

Thank you all for the support, new updates are coming as always! [/p]

notes.title: Sound Settings, Car Levels Checkpoints and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
This patch includes Sound Settings, Car Levels Checkpoints and several bug fixes:

1.Speedrun timer fix for boss levels ( it used to show 00:00,00, now it's fixed)
2.Speedrun timer added under the NoDeath mode medals
3.Some platforms were not going back and forth (so if you miss them you have to restart the level), but now they are.
4. Medal for S1L1 Medium is fixed now and it shows properly in Level Select (S1)
5. S2L4 music is looping properly now
6. No Death Mode had a sound issue, the death sound was playing and overlapping each time you got hit, now it doesn't
7. The lion pihs in S3L6 in the beginning of the level weren't running back after killing the player, which would result in a continuous loop of death if you got killed by the spawn point, now it's fixed.


As always, let me know if you encounter any new issues, and I will fix them, thank you all for the support!

notes.title: S2 Level 14 Small Update
notes.notes:
I removed a few collectibles that were being missed by people playing on easy or very easy mode. Players were getting to the end of the level, which is already a huge task, just to see that  they miss 2-3 collectibles. 

That was happening because they were blending in with the background so I decided to just remove those, and now all the collectibles are being picked if you stay on the main path ( for those 2 difficulty modes).

notes.title: Minor bug fixes
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:

1. Season 3 Level 7 -  35th collectible item was fixed and is now rendering correclty
2. I disabled instanced stereo for non-VR launch ( it's only supposed to affect the VR launch, but for some reason some people couldn't launch the game because of it)
3. Season 3 Level 12 -  Fixed the shadow inside tunnels, now you can see the road it's not all black
4. Season 3 Level 13 -  Fixed the red portal and make the bright lights less blinding
5. Season 2 Level 14 - Fixed the issue where the music was stopping

notes.title: Level 14 Bug fix + optimization
notes.notes:
There was a bug towards the end of level 14 which got introduced with one of the previous updates. If you got stuck in an area ( around 253 items collected ) , there are now some extra cubes of ice that you can jump on to move forward.

Also, for lower end PCs there should be an improvement in FPS for this level.

notes.title: VFX update
notes.notes: Changed a part of the VFX for the ice bullet so it won't block the view if you walk forward while using it, also changed the VFX for destroying the ice ham or the fire ham ( when you shoot them with the ice bullet )

notes.title: Minor bug fix + speedrun default off
notes.notes: Fixed some small bugs around the game and turned speedrun off by default for new players for a better first time player experience. You can turn it back on in settings.

notes.title: Bug fix + crosshair
notes.notes: Fixed some bugs for season 2 and added a crosshair to the game (it can be turned off in the settings menu)
